items.title: Joe Mares Jr. Interview, 1960-04-08
items.q: He was also a very good friend of mine. And I know Abby, we came up together.

ctx.x: That's all. He plays on the Mardi Gras Parade all the way through. And then on the Lost My Heart in Dixieland, he takes a solo with Bob Havens. They take a two trombone solo. So Emil Christians is another one that I've had the good faith of and happy to say that I gave him a band also, that this old gent could also say that he had a band of his own for his family or from years to come, you know, that he had something to a band of his own.
Another fellow who's gone now, young Abby Brunis, the drummer. Do you have any recollections of him?

Oh, very much so. He was also a very good friend of mine. And I know Abby, we came up together. And Abby was a real fine Dixieland drummer too. In fact, I put him with Sharky when he started to come back playing Dixieland. That was in 1952. And he stayed with Sharky until he died. But Abby was a good boy. He's the nephew of the Merritt and Abby Brunis and Henry and the real Brunis family, Georgie and them. And the boy was just about hitting his height when he went on to Beyond's.
